anomalies.obs: On the 'LEDs' sheet the WS2812B strip is D22-D9-D4-D11-D3-D2-D40. The VSS (ground) pins of D22, D9, D11 and D40 are tied to the GND bus with junction dots, but the VSS pins of D4, D3 and D2 carry red no-connect (X) flags and are left floating off the GND bus.
anomalies.exp: All seven WS2812B LEDs are intended status LEDs (spec: 'Addressable status LEDs (WS2812B ...)'); each VSS must be tied to GND. A WS2812B with an unconnected VSS is unpowered and, sitting in the middle of the daisy-chain, also loads/corrupts the DIN/DOUT line, so D4, D3, D2 and everything downstream (D11, D3, D2, D40) fail to light or misbehave.

evidence.quote: LEDs sheet: WS2812B symbols D4, D3, D2 show an X (no-connect flag) on the VSS pin while the GND rail below connects only to D22, D9, D11, D40
Addressable status LEDs (WS2812B, D5-D7, D18-D21) ... (the seven-LED strip is intended to function)

anomalies.impact: Three of the seven addressable status LEDs (and likely the downstream LEDs in the chain) will not operate, breaking the status-LED function of the board.

anomalies.obs: The CAN bus lines leaving the isolated transceivers U1/U12 to the M12 connectors J2/J25 (NET0063, NET0131, etc.) have only the 120R termination (R82/R34) and DIP switch; no SM712/CDSOT23 TVS diode array appears anywhere on the CAN nets in the drawing.
anomalies.exp: Spec lists 'D9, D10 - CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N' as the intended transient/ESD protection for the CAN buses.

evidence.quote: D9, D10 - CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays on CAN0_P/N, CAN1_P/N ... the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice
CAN BUS sheets: U1/U12 transceiver outputs run to J2/J25 with R82/R34 120R and SW7 only; no 6-pin TVS array is drawn

anomalies.impact: CAN buses lose the specified ESD/transient protection, increasing risk of latch-up or damage on the long external M12 runs.

parsed.summary: The schematic reproduces the spec's architecture (16 MHz CAN crystals, LTC4412+P-MOS USB OR-ing, two MCP2515+isolated transceivers, e-stop buffers, 7-LED WS2812B strip), but the drawing shows no-connect flags on the VSS pins of three WS2812B LEDs (D4/D3/D2), which is a deviation that disables part of the status-LED chain; the CAN TVS arrays named in the spec also appear absent.
